title: Dario Cannizzaro
_comment_promise: THE PROMISE LINE. This is the one thing the whole site hangs on. Swap `promise` and `promiseSupport` here and every page updates.
promiseSupport: This is where my writing lives: road trips with death, priests who fight zombies, detectives who travel back in time to solve a modern murder, roadside diners that vanish unwilling strangers to change the timeline. Welcome to my world.
_comment_greeting: THE FRONT PAGE GREETING. One array entry per paragraph; rendered in uppercase Helvetica over the right half of the hero. Placeholder copy by Claire, 2026-09-09 — Dario rewrites in his own words. Keep it short: the hero is 340px tall and the signature sits under it.
greeting: Hello, and thank you for stopping by.
Here on my small site you'll find scripts you can ask to read, a few things you can read right now, and a door in the woods that should not open, but does.
Mind the cracks where wonder lives.
metaDescription: Dario Cannizzaro is an Italian-Irish writer, screenwriter and director. Head of Story at True Story Studios. Author of the best-selling novel Dead Men Naked.
_comment_location: Two forms, deliberately. `location` is the full sentence form and is used only where it sits inside prose (the contact page). `locationShort` is the metadata form — the homepage eyebrow and the colophon — where the full one overflows its column and wraps. Keep the `//` in both: it is the site's mark for the two bases.
_comment_portrait: About-page portrait, 200x260. Placeholder in place — overwrite src/assets/img/portrait.jpg with the same filename. Leave the field empty and the slot renders as if it never existed.
_comment_images: hero, portrait and signature are placeholders generated by tools/placeholders.py — overwrite the file with your own picture, SAME FILENAME, and nothing else changes. hero: 640x340, black and white, subject on the left, right half dark (the greeting sits there). signature: 240x90 PNG, transparent, white ink. The STRIPS are not placeholders: Dario kept the dithered static (2026-09-09). 640x40 each, one shown at random per visit; add files to src/assets/img/strip/ and list them here.
_comment_counter: The visitor counter on the front page is real: Abacus (abacus.jasoncameron.dev), keyless, namespace/key below. `start` is the number the FIRST visitor sees — 100723, the day Dario quit Apple to write (10 July 2023); every visit after that adds one. Change the key to begin again from `start`.
_comment_credentials: The proof band on the homepage. Four items, no more — the fifth one dilutes the other four. `lead` is the part that renders bright; `tail` the part that renders dim. BILLING RULE: Head of Story, never co-founder.
